verdict.rationale: Datadog has an AI layer (Bits AI), so it is fair to ask whether it can act as an MCP client and use external MCP servers' tools. The evidence pack shows no such capability. The documented Datadog MCP Server is the server role, exposing Datadog to other agents, and does not let Datadog consume external MCP tools. The Bits AI entry is a title only, with no mention of connecting MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
